name: Australia
params_note: params verified against LitCal general calendar 2027/2028 (epiphany=JAN6|SUNDAY_JAN2_JAN8; ascension=THURSDAY|SUNDAY; corpus_christi=THURSDAY|SUNDAY; eternal_high_priest=true|false). LitCal grade ints: 2 optional, 3 memorial, 4 feast, 5 feast of Lord, 6 solemnity.
sources: https://www.liturgybrisbane.net.au/learn/liturgy-lines/changes-to-the-calendar/ (2010 decree changes: Timothy&Titus, Louis de Montfort, Chanel, Paulinus, Fisher&More)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_calendars_of_the_Roman_Rite (Australia table: Champagnat, Peter To Rot, Dominic 3 Aug)
https://gcatholic.org/calendar/2027/AU-en (Epiphany/Ascension/Corpus Christi on Sunday; Dominic 3 Aug; Chanel 28 Apr)
https://cbdparish.org.au/?p=3503 and https://stmaryscathedral.org.au/?p=10359 (Dominic moved to 3 Aug)

celebrations.title: Saints Timothy and Titus, bishops
celebrations.note: RANK+DATE CHANGE of StsTimothyTitus (GRC 26 Jan memorial); kept 27 Jan as optional memorial to make room for Australia Day on 26 Jan.

celebrations.title: Saint Patrick, bishop
celebrations.note: RANK CHANGE of LitCal StPatrick (optional memorial in GRC; solemnity in Australia).

celebrations.title: Saint Peter Chanel, priest and martyr
celebrations.note: RANK CHANGE of existing LitCal event StPeterChanel. GRC optional memorial; obligatory memorial in Australia (Oceania patron). Louis de Montfort moves to 27 Apr.

celebrations.title: Saints John Fisher, bishop, and Thomas More, martyrs
celebrations.note: RANK CHANGE of existing LitCal event StsJohnFisherThomasMore. GRC optional; obligatory memorial in Australia (2010 decree).

celebrations.title: Saint Dominic, priest
celebrations.note: RANK CHANGE of existing LitCal event StDominic. Moved from GRC 8 Aug memorial to 3 Aug in Australia to make way for MacKillop.

celebrations.title: Saint Mary of the Cross (Mary MacKillop), virgin
celebrations.note: Liturgical books name her Mary of the Cross. Readings per Liturgy Brisbane 2011 (first reading changed from Judith to 1 Kings; psalm 31 to 63). 8 Aug is an Ordinary Time Sunday in some years; apply normal precedence.

moved.note: Optional memorial with Angela Merici (27 Jan); frees 26 Jan for Australia Day.
Optional memorial moved from 28 Apr to make way for Peter Chanel.
Optional memorial moved to 23 Jun so Fisher and More can be a memorial (Liturgy Brisbane). LitCal outputs StPaulinusNola on 22 Jun.

holy_days_transferred: Epiphany: Sunday between 2 and 8 January (gcatholic AU 2027 shows Sun 3 Jan).
Ascension: Seventh Sunday of Easter (gcatholic AU 2027 shows Sun 9 May).
Corpus Christi: Sunday after Trinity (gcatholic AU 2027 shows Sun 30 May).
Holyday-of-obligation list for Australia and any Sat/Mon transfer rule were NOT verified; none assumed.
26 Jan Australia Day and 25 Apr Anzac Day are days of prayer/votive, deliberately omitted.
